'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[2025 Gaza City offensive]]
***At least 91 [[Palestinians]] are killed in [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] attacks across the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/27/live-israel-launches-series-of-early-attacks-on-palestinians-in-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2025 Cambodian–Thai border crisis]]
**[[Royal Cambodian Armed Forces|Cambodian]] and [[Royal Thai Armed Forces|Thai forces]] reportedly exchange fire across their countries' [[Cambodia–Thailand border|shared border]] despite a [[ceasefire]] agreement in place since August. [https://www.nationthailand.com/news/general/40056006 (Nation Thailand)] 
*[[2025 deployment of federal forces in the United States]]
**[[U.S.]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] orders the deployment of [[United States Armed Forces|troops]] to [[Portland, Oregon]], saying he has directed [[United States Secretary of Defense|defense secretary]] [[Pete Hegseth]] to secure the "war-ravaged" city. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cddmn6ge6e2o (BBC News)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**The [[Pakistan Armed Forces]] kill 17 [[Pakistani Taliban|Taliban]] militants and recover weapons and ammunition in an overnight [[military operation|operation]] in [[Lakki Marwat District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://tribune.com.pk/story/2569281/security-forces-kill-17-terrorists-in-lakki-marwat-ibo-ispr (''The Express Tribune'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of Iraq]], [[Economy of Kurdistan Region]]
**[[Iraq]] resumes [[Petroleum industry in Iraq|oil exports]] from the [[Kurdistan Region]] through [[Turkey]]'s [[Ceyhan]] port, ending a suspension imposed in early 2023 due to an [[International Chamber of Commerce]] arbitration ruling against independent Kurdish exports. [https://apnews.com/article/iraq-oil-exports-resume-kurdistan-263c440d9a320949ebfe5d437087c8d5 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Karur crowd crush]]
** In [[Karur]], [[Tamil Nadu]], [[India]], a [[crowd crush]] at actor-politician [[Vijay (actor)|Vijay]]-led [[Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam]] (TVK) rally kills at least 39 people (including 10 children), and injures 83 others. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/tvk-vijay-rally-karur-updates-on-september-27-2025/article70102676.ece (''The Hindu'')] [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/massive-tragedy-in-tamil-nadu-as-31-dead-at-vijays-karur-rally-in-stampede-like-crush-latest-updates-101758989763650.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
*Eight people are killed after a bus collides head-on with a vehicle carrying oil in [[Panjgur]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], Pakistan. [https://tribune.com.pk/story/2569275/eight-killed-as-bus-collides-with-iranian-oil-vehicle-in-panjgur (''The Express Tribune'')]
*At least four people are killed when torrential rain causes [[flash flood]]ing across [[Arizona]], United States. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/arizona-floods-at-least-four-dead-in-torrential-rains-rescue-efforts-underway/articleshow/124189941.cms (''The Times of India'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[International sanctions against Iran]], [[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**The [[United Nations]] reimposes [[Economic sanctions|economic]] and military sanctions on [[Iran]] after [[France]], [[Germany]], and the [[United Kingdom]] trigger the [[Snapback mechanism of sanctions against Iran|snapback mechanism]] under [[United Nations Security Council|Security Council]] [[United Nations Security Council Resolution 2231|Resolution 2231]] and the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action]], citing Iran's nuclear escalation and lack of cooperation with the [[International Atomic Energy Agency|IAEA]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crme84w3n23o (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-defiant-restored-sanctions-it-recalls-ambassadors-2025-09-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**[[2025 Southport shooting]]
***At least three people are killed and eight others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] when a gunman on a [[boat]] opens fire at a restaurant at the Southport Yacht Basin in [[Southport, North Carolina|Southport]], [[North Carolina]], United States. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/09/gunman-on-boat-opens-fire-at-restaurant-in-southport-north-carolina/ (BNO News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Gabonese parliamentary election]]
**[[Gabon]]ese citizens vote to elect members of the [[National Assembly of Gabon|National Assembly]] alongside municipal elections. A [[Two-round system|second round]] will be held on 11 October for constituencies where no candidate has a majority. [https://apnews.com/article/election-gabon-oil-africa-military-junta-97f5c3d8a931d14102f563f718963834 (AP)]
*[[2025 Seychellois general election]]
**[[Seychelles|Seychellois]] vote to elect a [[President of Seychelles|president]] and members of the [[National Assembly (Seychelles)|National Assembly]]. A [[Two-round system|second round]] will be held after no presidential candidate received a majority of the vote, with [[United Seychelles]] candidate [[Patrick Herminie]] receiving 48.8% of the vote over the incumbent [[Wavel Ramkalawan]]'s 46.4%. [https://apnews.com/article/seychelles-election-rerun-vote-presidential-election-ef1a2fa39707b0272e753dd9df64aa6a (AP)]

**[[England women's national rugby union team|England]] defeats [[Canada women's national rugby union team|Canada]] in the [[2025 Women's Rugby World Cup final|final]] of the 2025 [[Women's Rugby World Cup]]. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/rugby-union/articles/czjvgj81y2mo (BBC News)]
